verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an official Web SDK that ships TypeScript types, with an extensive method reference covering client creation, connect, quotes, buy, Apple Pay, Google Pay, card, auth, challenge and credentials frames. It also lists an official React Native SDK and a guide for generating typed clients from its OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Missing for 10: native iOS, Android, Flutter and server-side SDKs (native platforms must drive frames directly), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
